content.value_statement: Multi-agent systems can waste tokens, time, and compute when work is poorly coordinated. This skill guides profiling, workload distribution, and cost controls for reliable agent workflows.
actual_capabilities: Establishes baseline metrics and target performance goals.
Profiles database, application, and frontend agent workloads for bottlenecks.
Recommends context compression, semantic filtering, and token budget management.
Designs parallel execution and workload distribution strategies.
Outlines cost tracking, adaptive model selection, caching, and result reuse.
Defines monitoring loops and repeatable validation steps.
limitations: Does not include runnable production agents or complete implementation code.
Requires measurable metrics or evaluation data to be useful.
Does not replace load testing, observability tools, or human release approval.
Focuses on multi-agent systems, not single prompt tuning.

use_cases.title: Reduce Agent Workflow Latency
use_cases.description: Identify coordination delays, parallelize safe work, and define measurements for faster multi-agent task completion.

use_cases.title: Control LLM Operating Costs
use_cases.description: Plan token budgets, caching rules, and model selection strategies that preserve quality while reducing spend.

use_cases.title: Plan Reliable Orchestration Rollouts
use_cases.description: Create staged optimization plans with baselines, regression checks, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Profile a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to profile my multi-agent workflow for $TARGET. Identify likely bottlenecks, required metrics, and first optimization steps.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Coordination
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize coordination for $TARGET with goals of $PERFORMANCE_GOALS. Recommend workload distribution, parallel execution, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Cost
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply this skill to reduce multi-agent cost for $TARGET within $BUDGET_CONSTRAINTS while maintaining $QUALITY_METRICS.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Optimization Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a comprehensive multi-agent optimization plan for $TARGET using $OPTIMIZATION_SCOPE, $PERFORMANCE_GOALS, $BUDGET_CONSTRAINTS, and $QUALITY_METRICS.

output_examples.input: A support triage workflow has slow handoffs between classification, policy lookup, and reply drafting agents.
output: Baseline latency and token usage for each agent stage.
A parallelization plan for policy lookup and draft preparation.
A validation checklist covering quality, escalation accuracy, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: An enterprise API analysis workflow uses expensive models for every agent task.
output: A task complexity map for model selection decisions.
Caching and context compression recommendations for repeated analysis.
Cost and quality metrics to track before production rollout.

output_examples.input: A research assistant pipeline needs better reliability across planner, search, synthesis, and review agents.
output: A workload distribution plan with retry and review points.
Suggested monitoring metrics for throughput, failures, and answer quality.
A staged rollout plan with regression tests.

best_practices: Set measurable latency, cost, throughput, and quality targets before applying orchestration changes.
Test each optimization with repeatable evaluations and clear rollback criteria.
Use caching, context limits, and model selection only when quality thresholds remain satisfied.
anti_patterns: Optimizing without baseline metrics or before identifying bottlenecks.
Deploying broad coordination changes without staged rollout or regression checks.
Using the skill for a single prompt issue instead of a multi-agent workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill run external commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a guidance document with illustrative examples and does not include executable automation.

faq.question: Can it help with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide optimization plans for multi-agent workflows that use Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target workflow, performance goals, optimization scope, budget limits, and quality metrics.

faq.question: Is this useful for a single-agent prompt?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for coordination, cost, and reliability issues across multiple agents.

faq.question: Does it replace observability tooling?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan what to measure, but teams still need monitoring, logs, traces, and evaluations.

faq.question: How should changes be released?
faq.answer: Release changes gradually with baseline comparisons, regression tests, quality gates, and rollback criteria.
